name: One chamber
summary: A single air-filled chamber, 6 m on a side, 15 m down in bare Giza limestone. The simplest thing any method must find.

frame.axes: x east, y north, z up; metres

features.name: Chamber
features.source: Test geometry: the ground truth the methods are scored against.

notes: Depth, size and the host rock are swept in the detectability experiment; this file is the reference case.
Bare rock, as on most of the plateau: a loose sand cover (S waves near 300 m/s) needs a grid about three times finer, and runs with one are planned.

gated.title: What the gated reconstruction computes over the bench

volumes.note: At the force where corner reflectors let the favourable detector find the bench's chamber (2.5e+10 N), the gated reconstruction, unchanged, passes 633 positions at a support of one without the chamber and 635 with it; the chamber changes the scores at 646 positions (32 within 12 m of it, where 3% of positions lie), random noise of the same size at 648 (32). Its changes do not gather over the chamber: where the data hold the chamber, the reconstruction does not read it.

gated.note: Over the one-chamber bench, on synthetic products the unchanged gated pipeline reads as it reads a real one, shaken as Giza shakes (0.2 Hz, and the measured 1-3 Hz level on its mode 2, 2.14 Hz), 275 of 2,601 positions pass at a support of one without the chamber and 277 with it. The chamber's real imprint changes 4,875 of the 10.5 million values the pipeline reads and the fit scores at 178 (6 within 12 m of the chamber) of the positions, where 3% of positions lie so near; a random perturbation of the same size at the same pixels changes 182 (4 within 12 m of the chamber). Boosted ten thousand times the imprint changes 242 (6 within 12 m of the chamber); a hundred million times, 3.6 mm/s of line-of-sight motion over the chamber at 2.14 Hz, 300 (9 within 12 m of the chamber), 1 of them largest at the chamber's depth. At no boost do the changes gather over the chamber: what the method draws over the bench does not depend on it.
